import re
with open('tasks/t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp/assets/paper/10.1016_j.neuron.2012.08.041/files/rivlin-etzion_2012_directional-preference-reversal.xml', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', data)
text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
# Find the methods section
idx = text.lower().find('experimental procedures')
if idx == -1:
    idx = text.lower().find('methods')
print(f'Found at: {idx}')
print(text[idx:idx+5000] if idx != -1 else 'no')
